name: e2e
description: Write, run, and debug end-to-end tests for web and mobile apps with e2e, the open source agentic test runner.

interface.longDescription: Use e2e to add end-to-end tests to a project, write tests that mix agent goals with exact locator assertions, run them in a browser or on an iOS simulator, Android emulator, or phone, and fix failures from the run's trace. Drive the running app over the e2e MCP server to check a UI change, explore an app toward a goal, or bug bash a branch with each bug proven by a repro test.
defaultPrompt: Add e2e tests for the sign-up flow
Check my UI change in the running app
Bug bash this branch and prove each bug with a test
